  SELECT 
    DESYNPUF_ID,
    CLM_PMT_AMT,
    CASE WHEN B.SP_DIABETES = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_diabetic
  FROM inpatient_claims C
  JOIN diabetic_beneficiaries B ON C.DEESYNPUF_ID = B.DEESYNPUF_ID
  WHERE B.year = 2010
  UNION ALL

  FROM outpatient_claims C
  JOIN diabetic_beneficiaries B ON C.DEESYNPUF_ID = B.DEESYNPUF_ID
  WHERE B.year = 2010
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    DESYNPUF_ID,
    CLM_PMT_AMT,
    CASE WHEN B.SP_DIABETES = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_diabetic
  FROM carrier_claims C
  JOIN diabetic_beneficiaries B ON C.DEESYNPUF_ID = B.DEESYNPUF_ID
  WHERE B.year = 2010
),
beneficiary_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    DESYNPUF_ID,

question: How many members had higher Medicare inpatient reimbursement in each successive year from 2008 to 2010?

C1.label: logic
C1.sql:
WITH
  y08 AS (SELECT DESYNPUF_ID, MEDREIMB_IP FROM beneficiary WHERE year = 2008),
  y09 AS (SELECT DESYNPUF_ID, MEDREIMB_IP FROM beneficiary WHERE year = 2009),
  y10 AS (SELECT DESYNPUF_ID, MEDREIMB_IP FROM beneficiary WHERE year = 2010),
  inc09 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM y08 e08
    JOIN y09 e09 ON e08.DESYNPUF_ID = e09.DESYNPUF_ID
    WHERE e09.MEDREIMB_IP > e08.MEDREIMB_IP
  ),
  inc10 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM y09 e09
    JOIN y10 e10 ON e09.DESYNPUF_ID = e10.DESYNPUF_ID
    WHERE e10.MEDREIMB_IP > e09.MEDREIMB_IP
  )
SELECT '2008-2009' AS period, cnt FROM inc09
UNION ALL
SELECT '2009-2010' AS period, cnt FROM inc10;
